candidates.change_summary: Replace the single return statement to negate the stored mapping value, causing approvedToLog to return the inverse of approvedLoggers[_caller].
Removed onlyOwner guard from setApprovedLogger so any caller can change approvedLoggers.
Changed onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (no require), so functions using it no longer restrict to owner (affects setApprovedLogger when modifier present).
Inverted the assignment in setApprovedLogger to set the opposite boolean value, so callers intending to enable a logger will disable it and vice versa.
Replace the onlyOwner-restricted assignment with an assignment that sets approvedLoggers[_logger] to the opposite of provided _status, changing resulting stored value.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can change approvedLoggers, altering who can successfully change the state.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (always true), so setApprovedLogger no longer restricted and can change state when called by non-owner.
Invert the approval check so logCreated returns true when sender is NOT approved and returns false when approved (negate condition).
Always emit the event but always return false regardless of approval status (change return to false unconditionally).
Require approval, making the function revert when caller is not approved instead of returning false (use require instead of if-return).
Skip emitting the event when caller is approved but still return true (move emit behind a negated check so approved callers do not emit).
Always return true (remove approval check and event emission still occurs), changing return for unapproved callers.
Change the early-guard to check the _requester instead of msg.sender, so callers approved to log no longer determine success; returns true when _requester is approved even if msg.sender is not.
Invert the guard so the function returns false when caller is approved and proceeds (returning true) only when caller is not approved.
Remove the guard entirely so the function always emits and returns true regardless of approved loggers.
Make the function return the negation of the previous return: return false when it previously returned true by returning the opposite of the approval check after emitting.
